title: deploymentProof
responsibility: Hashes the complete deployment configuration so a plan cannot outlive a changed environment mapping.

inputs.name: deploymentProof.config
inputs.description: Validated environment mapping whose target identities and promotion boundaries must remain unchanged.

inputs.name: deploymentBlockers.root
inputs.description: Absolute Git repository directory whose source and deployment receipts are inspected.

inputs.name: deploymentBlockers.query
inputs.description: Requested immutable source commit and destination environment.

inputs.name: deploymentBlockers.config
inputs.description: Validated environment mapping whose target identities and promotion boundaries must remain unchanged.

inputs.name: deploymentHealth.target
inputs.description: Configured destination identity and health URL; credentials are never exposed in the UI.

inputs.name: deploymentCurrent.root
inputs.description: Absolute Git repository directory whose source and deployment receipts are inspected.

inputs.name: deploymentCurrent.plan
inputs.description: Reviewed immutable source and destination with expiry and blocking conditions.

inputs.name: deploymentCurrent.guard
inputs.type: { plugin: DeploymentPlugin; fingerprint: string; phase?: string }
inputs.description: Reviewed configuration or destination proof that must still match before the next step.

outputs.name: deploymentProof
outputs.description: SHA-256 digest of the serialized deployment configuration.

outputs.name: deploymentBlockers
outputs.description: Blocking reasons, source branch and, for production, preprod/production comparison.

outputs.name: deploymentHealth
outputs.description: True only when the health endpoint returns a successful response without redirects.

outputs.name: deploymentCurrent
outputs.description: Current validated configuration; rejects if source, configuration or promotion changed.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unsafe source, target or promotion state; no successful deployment receipt is recorded.
